trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlocked automatically after acquiring all other 54 trophies across Leonida. Culmination of the 100% completion roadmap.
trophies.citation: Source: PSNProfiles Leonida Roadmap & Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story mission progression. Conclude the introductory chapter prologue mission "Gone Fishing" along the mangrove wetlands.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story progression. Complete all mandatory syndicate operations across Port Gellhorn concluding Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story milestone. Finish all core narrative contracts in the nightclub and smuggling circuit ending Chapter 2.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Story Missions

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story milestone. Awarded after securing the premier Ocean Beach penthouse hideout and finishing Chapter 3.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Story Missions

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story milestone. Clear the high-altitude corporate tower extraction mission concluding Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Campaign finale. Complete the climactic joint operation and watch the ending credits sequence roll.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story mission. Finish "Breakfast Run", which introduces cooperative partner combat commands and synchronized takedowns.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Heist milestone. Complete all required reconnaissance boards, breach security, and escape with the Cartel bullion haul.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Heist Walkthroughs

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story mission. Successfully protect the suburban safehouse and family contacts during mission "Child's Play".

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story mission. Infiltrate the VIP backstage mezzanine and extract target intel in mission "Headliners".
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Story Missions

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story mission. Intercept the outbound private cargo jet on the VCIA airfield runway during "VCIA Takedown".

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story mission. Raid the fortified coastal contraband depot during heavy oceanic weather conditions.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion in the Pause Menu checklist: all main missions, 8 stranger strands, 250 stunts, shooting challenges, cards, and properties.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 unique stunt jumps, billboard ramps, and precision bridge drifts throughout Leonida county roads.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Stunt Map & Jump Locations

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Participate in every recreational mini-game at least once: bowling, arcade cabinet, drone race, street race, fishing, and meditation.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Achieve gold target scores across all 42 weapon firing trials at Ammu-Nation (Pistols, SMGs, Rifles, Shotguns, Heavy).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Locate all 8 Top Fun drone obstacle course terminals in Vice City and the Keys, winning 1st place in each race.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Drone Challenges

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Place first in 20 distinct street races, off-road rallies, and speedboat circuits around the Leonida waterways.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Head to the marina in the Florida Keys backcountry and catch a heavier trophy bass or tarpon than Cal within 5 minutes.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any retro arcade machine in a local tavern or boardwalk arcade and clear all stages to beat the high score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete all 4 Stranger & Freak encounters for Andy starting outside the county clinic to finish his arc.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's offshore shipwreck salvage chain culminating in recovery of the sunken submarine crate.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Strangers & Freaks

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the 3 desert outpost motorcycle trials for veteran rider Billy along the western ridge.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full multi-stage Stranger & Freak questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, and 3 others).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Fulfill Randy's swamp contraband supply network deliveries across the airboat channels to finish his story.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Strangers & Freaks

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Help vinyl collector Tyrone recover master recordings and reclaim his audio studio from rival promoters.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Interact with all 12 panoramic meditation yoga mats positioned at cliff summits, rooftops, and quiet coastal shores.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track down and hunt the legendary albino alligator in the deep marshlands using hunting lure for Bret's trophy lodge.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collect all 30 cards across 3 complete sets (Vice Legends, Neon Muscle, Leonida Fauna) scattered in hidden spots.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Collectible Card Map

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Tag WAiNK social app camera check-ins at 100 designated architectural monuments, murals, and scenic spots.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 weapon, driving, combat, and criminal feats listed in the Career Challenges interface.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE ALERT: Attain a 4-star wanted level while riding together with your partner in free-roam, break police line of sight in backstreets, and evade heat.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE ALERT: Rob 3 consecutive 24/7 convenience stores with your partner companion present while continuously maintaining police pursuit.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Robbery Tactics

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Enter the driver seat of 100 distinct vehicle models (sedans, coupes, exotics, bikes, boats, choppers) to catalogue them.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus slow-motion capability and score 5 quick headshot eliminations before the adrenaline meter expires.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Infiltrate Vice City International Airport runway, hijack any commercial jet or jetliner, and take off successfully.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Special Feats

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Enter the fortified military perimeter, commandeer a Rhino armored tank, and maintain control inside for 2 continuous minutes.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE ALERT: Choose the stealth reconnaissance option for the Vivaldi Diamond Heist. Deploy sleeping gas through HVAC vents, collect gems, and slip out undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Successfully crack open the vault doors of 5 major commercial banks across Leonida, loot safety deposit boxes, and escape.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Bank Vault Heists

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Ambush a random armored cash transport on the highway, blow open the reinforced back doors with plastic explosives, take cash, and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unveil 100% of the world map fog across all metropolitan districts, suburban canals, swamps, and oceanic borders.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Raid and clean out an illegal production lab or stash house belonging to each of the 4 hostile factions in the state.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Gang Warfare

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order and sip a signature cocktail at the open-air Ocean Beach rooftop terrace during evening golden hour.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Hijack the exotic showcase supercar inside the luxury dealership showroom and burst through the plate-glass facade onto the avenue.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a ten-pin bowling match at Kolt & Associates lanes and score three strikes in a row (a turkey).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the duo syndicate chemistry rating and social live-stream follower audience during story milestones.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: CRITICAL MISSABLE: During the decisive moral choice at the end of Chapter 3, commit to the mutual trust pact rather than betrayal.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Story milestone. Survive the prisoner transport ambuscade and regroup safely at the backcountry safehouse.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the classified deep-space radio observatory anomaly in the northern backcountry at 3:00 AM in rainy weather.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Easter Eggs & Secrets

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While operating a motorcycle or scooter, strike and knock down 5 pedestrians with a baseball bat in rapid succession.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Process dirty heist bills through acquired front properties (car washes, laundromats) to clean $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across boutique clothing stores, weapon modifications, and performance vehicle tuning shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 7 garage properties and lockups listed on the Dynasty8 real estate website across Leonida.
trophies.citation: Source: Leonida State Explorer's Field Guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Locate and deliver 10 designated scooters and vintage mopeds to drop points requested via the in-game Scooter Bros app.
trophies.citation: Source: GTA Series Guides - Vehicle App Deliveries
